features.fullDescription: Four-storey tower-house with vaulted basement and projecting wings. May date late 16th cent., but much altered at later periods. Armorial stone south frontage 1714. Fine interiors: carved chimney pieces, painted ceiling, private chapel with communion chair/table 1623.
